name: Tablet Cast (v3, Velum)
author: henri
description: While the tablet shows this Mac (mac-cast through ipadcast): the tablet and its battery in the menu bar; a click grows the right island into its numbers — battery, draw, latency, connection, frame and data rate, screen — and a brightness slider for its panel. Hidden while no tablet is connected.

barWidget.description: The casting tablet, its battery and stream; only while it is connected
